answer: Like a jetty, one agent may tie up only after staking 5,000 tokens locked 30 days. Each identity must finish a unique paid task on a public terrace of work — verified output, not a signature — so every fake costs 5,000 tokens plus 30 days of illiquidity. A reputation vine links attestations: if one node vouches for ten clones, the whole vine is pruned and 25% of the shared stake is slashed. A farm is caught when 40 identities submit identical outputs within one hour — a pattern no single human can produce — and the cluster is frozen before payout.
